decisions.date_basis: arXiv submission history lists v1 2026-09-30T17:50:22Z and no later version on 2026-10-05.
decisions.old_problem: T2 distinguishes recursive synthetic-data replacement and accumulation, but does not yet cover the marginal value of uncurated AI-written web text when the human corpus stays fixed, or masking by the validation mixture.
decisions.mechanism: A saturating effective-token credit is combined with a separate harm term; both token value and the sign of a measured change depend on the evaluation target. This is an extension of data-mixture and effective-data questions, not a refutation of every use of synthetic data.

evidence.design: 800 nanochat models, 19.9M–973M parameters (including input embeddings), human token budgets 2.9–87.5 tokens/parameter, AI-to-human token ratios 0–64; paired additions to fixed human controls, with fresh-human additions as a comparator.
evidence.fit_and_check: 726 models at 19.9M–268M for coefficient fitting; 74 models at 477M/973M reserved. Appendix D.1 also scores alternative functional forms on these reserved sizes.
evidence.law: L=E+A/N^alpha+[B/D_eff^beta](1+H), D_eff=D_H[1+eta R*(1-exp(-r/R*))], r=D_A/D_H, R*=K t^rho, t=D_H/(20N), H=gamma t^u n^v[log(1+r)-r/(1+r)], n=N/10^8.
evidence.primary_metric: Paired RMSE of the change in log loss relative to each human-only control, not absolute loss RMSE or task accuracy.
evidence.validation_mixture: Of 553 AI-addition runs, 243 worsen human-labeled FW26 loss. A mixed target with 22.3% AI-labeled tokens presents 95.5% of those harmful runs as improvements (§5.2).
evidence.reported_prediction_comparison: C4 paired RMSE is 0.83e-3 versus 1.41e-3 for the strongest existing human-target comparator, Shukor joint; the roughly 41% decrease concerns this metric over the tested AI ratios. Omitted from proposed body to avoid overstating independent validation.
key_boundaries: Added tokens increase total training compute; this is not an equal-total-compute substitution experiment.
English web text, one training recipe, detector-derived provenance labels, and models below 1B. Corpus composition and topic/format differences can matter.
WildAI's enriched AI share is not an estimate of AI prevalence across the entire web.
The next-token-loss results do not establish broad capability collapse; the authors report CORE gains comparable to fresh human additions at these small sizes.
Appendix D.1 uses the reserved large sizes for candidate-form comparison and discusses choosing among penalties. Do not label the reported improvement an entirely untouched final test.
Forecasts of future AI prevalence and compute-equivalent cost are extrapolations, not observations; omitted from body suggestion.

suggested_insertion.position: In §9 after the recursive replacement/accumulation distinction and before §10; a short subsection about uncurated web AI text and evaluation mixtures.
suggested_insertion.relation_to_existing_work: Connects T2 effective-data credit and Shukor joint mixtures to the synthetic-feedback discussion. Shukor joint is a direct benchmark comparator in this primary source.

source_record.title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text
source_record.problem: 固定人类语料后，来自网页的 AI 文本是否仍能按正的有效 token 计入；混合验证集会不会遮蔽人类文本上的退化？
source_record.insight: 将饱和的数据收益与单独的危害项分开，并分别测量人类、AI 与混合目标；边际 token 价值与评估分布相关。
source_record.limitation: 800 个不足 1B 的模型、单配方、英语、检测器标签；添加数据增加计算量；loss 不等于能力；保留大规模实验同时参与候选形式比较，不能称为完全独立的最终测试；未复现。
source_record.reading_depth: 核验 arXiv 版本历史及作者；定向阅读 v1 HTML 摘要、§1–6、Appendix B 的参数计数、C.2–C.3 比较形式、D–D.1 拟合和选择、E 的度量说明；未完整审计所有附录、图像、代码或实验。
source_record.narrative_use: 新增 T2 的有条件证据：网页 AI 文本的收益与危害，以及验证分布掩盖。
source_record.metadata_notes: arXiv abstract page uses Ben Glickenhaus; HTML title page uses Benjamin Glickenhaus. Author list follows arXiv metadata. v1 timestamp: 2026-09-30T17:50:22Z.

decisions.proposed_text_zh:
递归替换并不是生成文本进入训练的唯一方式。[Russell et al.，2026 年 9 月 30 日](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.40295v1)研究自然出现在网页中的未经专门策划的 AI 文本。在 800 个模型（19.9M–973M 参数）上，作者固定人类文本语料，再添加被检测器标为 AI 的 token。总 token 和计算量随之增加，因此这不是固定计算量的替换实验。其规律把饱和的数据收益与依赖人类数据预算、模型规模的危害项分开：添加文本起初可能帮助数据不足的模型，随后却提高人类文本 loss，而新增人类文本仍然有用。

评估分布会改变结论。在含 22.3% AI 标签 token 的混合 FW26 验证集上，95.5% 的、会损害其中人类标签子集的运行，在整体指标中看起来反而改善。这支持分别报告两类子集。证据限于英语、检测器标注的网页文本、一套预训练配方及不足 1B 的模型，不能确立普遍的能力崩塌，也不能一概否定经过策划的合成数据。候选函数形式的比较也使用了较大的保留模型规模，因此不能把这些结果描述为完全未参与选择的最终测试。
decisions.proposed_text_en:
Recursive replacement is not the only way generated text enters training. [Russell et al., 30 September 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.40295v1) study uncurated AI text found on the web. Across 800 models (19.9M–973M parameters), they hold the human corpus fixed and add AI-labeled tokens. Total tokens and compute increase, so this is not a fixed-compute substitution test. Their law separates saturating data credit from harm dependent on human budget and model size: additions can initially help data-starved models, then raise human-text loss, while fresh human additions remain useful.

The evaluation distribution changes the conclusion. With 22.3% AI-labeled tokens in mixed FW26 validation, 95.5% of runs that worsen its human-labeled subset appear improved overall. This supports reporting the two subsets separately. The evidence concerns English, detector-labeled web text, one pretraining recipe, and models below 1B parameters. It does not establish general capability collapse or a universal verdict on curated synthetic data. Functional-form comparisons also use the larger reserved model sizes, so those results should not be described as a completely untouched final test.

decisions.date_basis: arXiv submission history lists v1 2026-10-01T20:35:12Z and no later version on 2026-10-05.
decisions.old_problem: T3 separates parameters, FLOPs, memory and real deployment cost, but does not yet ask how cheaply compression response can be predicted or whether an accurate response model changes method selection.
decisions.mechanism: Share a response shape across pruning densities, refit setting-specific coefficients, and evaluate both measurement efficiency and the decision value of predictions under an explicit nominal-storage constraint.

evidence.target: Teacher-forced, token-weighted reference-completion cross-entropy on 64 fixed probes per capability (MATH500, MBPP, 2Wiki QA); prompt tokens masked; units nats/native token. This is not generated-answer success rate.
evidence.pruning_form: Delta L_c(x,d)=A_c(x)[(1-d)/0.3]^gamma_c, where d is retained density and A_c is linear in standardized initial-state descriptors. The compact response is tested for math and code; QA does not share the same simple curve.
evidence.measurement_design: Pythia magnitude pruning, OLMo-2 magnitude pruning, and Pythia Wanda panels. Half-grid fits use 18/36 measurements per capability for Pythia or 12/24 for OLMo, with coefficients refitted separately on each panel.
evidence.result_scope: Math/code predictor MAE differs from the full-grid regression by at most 0.020 nats/token in those panels. This is a difference between prediction errors, not an absolute 0.020-error guarantee.
evidence.timing: Measured GPU time, including loading, reference measurements and calibration, is 59% of the full design for OLMo-2 and 70% for Wanda; half the configuration measurements does not mean half the total compute.
evidence.selection: Selection is evaluated under nominal stored-matrix-parameter budgets. On the tested QA candidates, fixed method priority attains the same regret as numerical prediction; little evidence that finer prediction causes the observed QA benefit.
key_boundaries: Cross-family/criterion transfer of the functional form is not zero-shot coefficient transfer; new settings require refitting.
Unseen source states can favor simple source-free median curves; extrapolation outside tested configurations can fail.
Nominal storage constraints are not measured latency, energy, FLOPs or whole-system cost.
Loss and generated-answer exact match can rank methods differently. Appendix H.2 end-marker controls do not remove that distinction.
Results depend on the implementations, probe distributions, configuration ranges and candidate set; code was not run or audited.

suggested_insertion.position: After §5's serving/storage discussion, as a short compression-response subsection; alternatively inside §7 after the lifecycle-cost argument.
suggested_insertion.relation_to_existing_work: Connects deployment constraints to T1's cost of fitting a predictor and T6's loss-to-capability boundary. Do not state a direct historical lineage unless supported by the cited paper.

source_record.title: Capability Scaling-Down Laws for LLM Compression
source_record.problem: 压缩方法、配置和初始模型不同会产生不同的分任务损失；能否减少拟合测量，并证明数值预测确实改善部署选择？
source_record.insight: 共享剪枝密度响应、逐设置重拟合系数，并把预测误差、测量成本与名义存储约束下的决策价值分开检验。
source_record.limitation: 目标为 teacher-forced 参考答案 loss，非生成成功率；跨设置需重拟合；半测量非半 GPU 时间；存储代理非实测服务成本；QA 固定方法优先序达到同等 regret；有配置与分布边界，未复现。
source_record.reading_depth: 核验 arXiv 作者及版本历史；定向阅读 v1 HTML 摘要、§1–6、§8、Appendix A.3 的实验组、C 的外推讨论、H.2 终止符控制、I–J；未完整审计所有附录、图像、代码或实验。
source_record.narrative_use: 新增 T3 的有条件压缩预测证据，明确减少测量、改善选择和改善硬件成本是三个不同命题。
source_record.metadata_notes: v1 timestamp: 2026-10-01T20:35:12Z. Published repository and claimed reproducibility artifacts were not independently inspected.

decisions.proposed_text_zh:
部署还需要预测压缩会损失什么。[Cheng et al.，2026 年 10 月 1 日](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.02462v1)研究剪枝、量化与蒸馏，以 teacher forcing 下参考答案的 loss 分别衡量数学、代码和问答；这个量不是任务成功率。跨保留密度共享剪枝响应后，拟合所需的配置测量减少一半；在每个设置分别重拟合系数的前提下，所测试的 Pythia、OLMo-2 和 Wanda 实验组中，数学与代码的预测误差与完整网格回归相差不超过 0.020 nats/token。节省的是测量数：OLMo-2 与 Wanda 的实际 GPU 时间仍分别为完整设计的 59% 和 70%。

部署决策又增加一层边界。选择依据是名义上的存储参数预算，不是实测延迟或能耗。对所测试的问答候选，固定的方法优先序与数值预测选择得到相同 regret；这种收益并不依赖精细预测。loss 的改善也未必提高生成答案的 exact match。因此，其贡献是用更少测量估计响应、并检验预测是否改变决策的有条件协议，而不是普适的系数迁移或能力与硬件成本定律。
decisions.proposed_text_en:
Deployment also requires predicting what compression will remove. [Cheng et al., 1 October 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.02462v1) study pruning, quantization, and distillation using teacher-forced reference-completion loss for mathematics, code, and question answering. This is not task success rate. Sharing a pruning response across densities reduces fitted configuration measurements by half; with coefficients refitted separately for each setting, math/code prediction errors stay within 0.020 nats/token of full-grid regression on the tested Pythia, OLMo-2, and Wanda panels. The saving concerns measurements: measured GPU time remains 59% of the full design for OLMo-2 and 70% for Wanda.

The deployment decision adds another boundary. Selection operates under nominal stored-parameter budgets, not measured latency or energy. On the tested question-answering candidates, a fixed method priority achieves the same regret as numerical selection; fine-grained prediction is not what explains that benefit. Loss gains also need not improve generated-answer exact match. The contribution is therefore a bounded protocol for cheaper response estimation and for checking whether prediction changes a decision; it does not establish universal coefficient transfer or a capability–hardware-cost law.
